title: Read and manage existing todos
summary: List, search, or inspect Todo records; decide pending concern-routing proposals; add notes; and mark a todo done or reopen it.
use_when: An existing concern, routing proposal, durable umbrella, direction history, note, lifecycle state, assessment, or design projection should be read.
A person has explicitly authorized a routing decision or an umbrella note/open-done transition.
do_not_use_when: A new concern should be captured and researched.
The task is to implement, plan, or prove completion of the underlying work.
A routing proposal's frozen basis is stale or authorization provenance is unavailable.
outcome: An exact Todo read or deterministic provenance-bearing identity, note, or lifecycle transition, without model authority or implementation claims.
effects: List, search, and show commands read Todo state without invoking Nucleus.
Routing accept/reject records an explicit decision using a readable UTF-8 source as authorization provenance.
Note add appends an immutable working note; done and reopen perform idempotent umbrella lifecycle transitions.
authority: Todo owns concern and umbrella identities, direction revisions, notes, routing decisions, lifecycle, assessments, and design projections.
Only deterministic CLI decision commands, not a model job or final prose, authorize routing.
success: Reads identify the exact public ID and current or historical state selected.
Routing acceptance applies a still-pending proposal whose complete frozen basis remains current.
Lifecycle and note writes are durably visible without being misrepresented as implementation execution.
failure_and_recovery: There is no force option for stale routing; reassess the original concern.
An attachment does not revise direction, a revision does not merge identities, and unification preserves superseded history.
Done/reopen does not prove that any particular plan ran; inspect external state separately.
privacy: Todo reads can expose source paths, directions, notes, assessment evidence references, and design content.
Decision sources must be readable UTF-8 at decision time; Todo stores their canonical paths, not contents.
does_not_authorize: Implementation or execution of the todo direction.
Inferring completion evidence from an open/done marker.
A routing decision without explicit readable decision-source provenance.
